build_singularity_environment: build a hardened Singularity container environment with resource limits and optional persistent filesystem overlay
run_bash_commands: run bash commands inside a running Singularity/Apptainer container instance with login shell support
build_sif_image: build a SIF container image from a docker:// source URL into a local cache directory with thread-safe locking
create_singularity_instance: create a secure Singularity instance with --containall, --no-home, capability dropping, and optional memory/CPU limits
test_cleanup_environment: test stopping a Singularity instance and saving overlay directory snapshots for persistent filesystem recovery
